inputs.original_text:
Open your eyes to what is really being hidden behind the scenes. South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday. The establishment wants you to believe their official cover story that it is just a routine administrative update to make new registered voters prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections. 

Do not fall for their narrative that it only applies to state elections and only impacts new registrants. That is a smokescreen designed to hide their true, calculated motives. The hidden elites pulling the strings in the shadows are engineering the system to tighten their grip and manipulate who gets to participate, using this as a calculated distraction from their ultimate agenda.
